decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets identified in allowed context [445,579]: (1) a divergent drift-like onset from index 480 with dominant U drop after 530 and no clear return; (2) a multi-axis step event ~540–550 with partial recovery but no confirmed opposing return before index 579. Both lack unambiguous return signatures on all affected axes; status marked uncertain. No confirmed temporary interval meets full onset–sustained–return criteria.

intervals.observation: U shows a multi-sample sharp drop starting ~530, not mirrored in N/E; N rises steadily from ~480, E has modest step near 520. No clear opposing return observed within allowed context (445–579); interior sustained but return ambiguous.

Multi-axis step centered ~540–550: U drops sharply (~538), N jumps negative then recovers, E jumps positive; all axes show coherent transient offset with partial recovery by 550. Return not fully completed before 551; post-550 behavior shows secondary adjustment but no full reversal to pre-step level within allowed context.
